Due Date.notes: Base RFP deadline appears consistently as March 28, 2025 at 1:00 PM; one clause adds the explicit time zone Eastern Time. No extension language was found in the supplied evidence.

Bid Submission Type.value: Paper submission only: the complete original proposal must be submitted in a sealed package, marked "CVSU CHROMEBOOKS," with an original and two copies, delivered to CVSU – Attn: Trey Cates, 111B Brush Hill Road, Williamstown, VT 05679, by 1:00 PM Eastern Time on March 28, 2025. Electronic communication is not accepted, proposals received after opening will not be accepted, and mailing it in time is not sufficient unless it is received before the closing time.

Term of Bid.value: 3-year lease term, with option to purchase all equipment at the end of the lease for $1.00 per unit.

sources.quote:
- CVSU desires to lease the equipment in this project for 3 years, with the option to
purchase all equipment at the end of the lease at the price of $1.00 per unit.

Installation.notes: Not found in documents; validation failed: The quotes support that equipment must be new, assembled, serviced, adjusted, and demonstrated to CVSU’s satisfaction, and that CVSU may request on-site demonstrations. However, they do not mention inside delivery, liftgate delivery, or the absence of loading docks, so the delivery portion of the value and notes is unsupported.

Payment Terms.value: Lease quotes must be separated for billing purposes according to school districts, include annual and bi-annual payment options, and initial lease payments must begin no earlier than 30 days after receipt of equipment. Proposals must also include lease terms with all fees, terms, rates, and payment schedule.

Any Additional Documentation Required.value: With the proposal: all documents necessary to support the proposal; an original and two copies of the proposal and supporting documents; a Non-Collusion Affidavit and Employment Eligibility Verification Certification on the attached forms; at least three references; conflict-of-interest disclosure naming any CVSU officer/director/co-owner/agent or spouse/relative who is a CVSU employee; proposal content including Chromebook model/features, case model/features, Chrome Console licensing detail, 3-year mail-in Accidental Damage Protection Warranty Detail, lease terms/fees/rates/payment schedule, and vendor information/signature. Prior to award: proof of insurance meeting the stated limits. Upon request: documentation regarding licenses, permits, certifications, and/or registrations required by law/regulation.

Product.value: CVSU is seeking to lease for 3 years, with an option to purchase at the end of the lease, HP Chromebooks with MaxCase Rugged Cases, Google Console Licensing, and a 3-year ADP warranty, to provide 1 device per student. Specific equipment listed includes HP Fortis Fx36011G5 N100 11 devices (model 9R398UT#ABA), HP 3y Offsite w/ADP Notebook extended warranty, HP EDU Google Chrome Mgmt Console E-LTU, and MaxCases Extreme Shell-F2 Slide Case. Total device units listed for CVSU: 1,231. Listed school quantities are Orange Center School 92, Washington Village School 112, Northfield Elementary School 231, Northfield Middle High School 300, Williamstown Elementary School 202, and Williamstown Middle High School 294. The RFP states there is no guarantee of volume and CVSU may lease or purchase more or less than the listed quantity depending on actual requirements and budget restraints.
